'''July 2001 Toronto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Nexus X, Bathurst and Bloor, Toronto, Ontario on 14 July 2001. It is known from Spencer Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2653">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14d2653/ ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14], DeckTech (Spencer "s_ skywalker" Ball, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-ball-goes-to-toronto-nexus-x-july-14d2653/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Nexus X, Bathurst and Bloor, Toronto, Ontario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
